name: cache-countdown
description: Counts down until this session's prompt cache goes cold, with an optional keep-warm ping for when you step away.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request. 60 normally; 5 when the session is in usage overage.

pingLeadMinutes.title: Ping lead (minutes)
pingLeadMinutes.description: While keep-warm is on, ping this many minutes before the cache would go cold.

warnMinutes.title: Warn at (minutes left)
warnMinutes.description: Show a toast when the cache has this many minutes left and keep-warm is off. 0 turns the warning off.

keepWarmMaxHours.title: Keep-warm limit (hours)
keepWarmMaxHours.description: Keep-warm switches itself off after this long, so a forgotten session doesn't ping forever.

stopWhenBack.title: Stop keep-warm when you're back
stopWhenBack.description: Switch keep-warm off as soon as you send your next message.
